dsh-memory-protocol is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Memory protocol enforcement plugin: bridges the opencode-memory MCP server, forces memory_weave before tool calls, auto-ingests turns, and injects memory context into agent steps.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-d8160b1aa8453843a29b.html
